title: Amazon-M2: A Multilingual Multi-locale Shopping Session Dataset for Recommendation and Text Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the long-tail distribution of product interaction frequencies and comparing the recommendation accuracy of a simple popularity heuristic against advanced deep learning models to demonstrate the data's skew towards popular items.

Evaluating the performance disparity and domain shift of recommendation algorithms by training models on large, well-represented locales (e.g., UK, DE, JP) and measuring their zero-shot or fine-tuned transferability to smaller, underrepresented locales (e.g., ES, IT, FR).
